=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt:19-22 (same text in prompts/_templates/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt:12-15) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `review_waiting_for_runner` bullet ends on the bare word "is" ("...or a trusted PR-named review dispatch run (which carries the default-branch SHA) is"), so the clause has no predicate. The bullet also leaves out the REVIEW_RUN_MAX_RUNTIME_MINUTES age limit, and the "Action guidance" bullet (line 47) lists only "queued, waiting or pending" and omits `requested`, so the prompt describes the flag two different ways.
  WHY: The stall judge model gets an unfinished and inconsistent definition of a context field, and the bullet overstates how long the flag lasts; the `escalate_human`/`close_and_reissue` hold is enforced in code, so the cost is prompt clarity only (all reviewers rated it NIT).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22578-22588 (test harness tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py `_sjr_*` lines 21663-21831, fake gh copy loop line 1859) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The waiting-run selector was widened to `or ((.head_branch // "") != $head_ref)` for the null-`head_branch` trusted PR-named dispatch case, but no test covers that arm: the `_sjr` fixtures stage only `branch: "ai/issue-10"` runs, and the fake `gh` copy loop does not copy `path`, `display_title` or `head_branch`.
  WHY: This arm is the only thing that holds escalation in the incident's shape, so if it regresses a reviewable PR is escalated to `ai:needs-human` again and no test fails (both reviewers rated it NIT).
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2766-2772 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The linked-PR diff read is still a single-attempt `gh api`, while the sibling reads at lines 1461 and 1478 are wrapped in `gh_retry`. On failure, `null` is written to linked_pr.json, which drops the PR from the judge context and, through `unblock_has_linked_pr` (line 1503), drops `--linked-pr-file` from the validate call (lines 2425-2427).
  WHY: One transient 502 restores the blind `retry_budget` path from the tele-funtoken-msg-scoring#5258 incident (MAJOR per minimax; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same issue only as hardening suggestions).
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1461-1478 (retry behavior in scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1214, 1230-1289) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `gh_retry` defaults to 5 attempts, so the linked-PR list and detail reads can reach up to 11 requests per run, not the documented "1, or 3 when an open PR is found".
  WHY: openai_gpt-6-luna (MAJOR) says this exceeds the issue's budget of one request per new call per judge invocation; minimax_minimax-m3 (NIT) says only the shipped numbers in changelog.d/9546-judge-blind-spots.md line 13 and agents.d/9546-judge-blind-spots.md are wrong. The highest severity is used here; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute that this is a defect at all (CONSIST-001 convention, retries only on transient errors).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  PROBLEM: The `review_waiting_for_runner` bullet ends on "is" with no predicate and leaves out the REVIEW_RUN_MAX_RUNTIME_MINUTES age limit; the "Action guidance" bullet lists only "queued, waiting or pending", so the prompt describes the flag two different ways.
  WHY: The judge model gets an unfinished rule. Code still holds escalate_human/close_and_reissue, so the cost is clarity only. Suggested fix: end the clause with "is requested, queued, waiting or pending, and younger than REVIEW_RUN_MAX_RUNTIME_MINUTES" in both files.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh unblock_ask_model, line 2766 | risk_score=2
  PROBLEM: The linked-PR diff read is a single attempt; one transient 5xx sets linked_pr.json to null (reason=diff_failed), removing linked_open_pr and the `#<pr>` validation rule.
  WHY: Suggested fix: prefix the call with `gh_retry` (it has a pass-through fallback at line 166), do not use gh_retry_to_file (no fallback), and add "diff" to the two CONSIST-001 comment lists; 1-3 lines.
- NOTES (4 related items): refutes the google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite claim about scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22579 (filter at 22528-22529 and trusted_pr_named at line 27944 limit the scope); refutes the openai_gpt-6-luna gh_retry call-count point (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1461 and 1478) as CONSIST-001 policy; says the gemini prompt-line task gap is already met by the "Action guidance" bullet; acknowledges the missing null-head_branch PR-named dispatch test but does not report it because the previous editor declined it.

- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2766 and lines 2768-2772 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The linked-PR diff read is a bare single-attempt `gh api`, while the sibling reads (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1461, 1478) use `gh_retry`. On failure, null is written to linked_pr.json, and via `unblock_has_linked_pr` (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1503) `--linked-pr-file` is dropped from validate (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2425-2427).
  WHY: One transient 502 restores the blind `retry_budget` path of tele-funtoken-msg-scoring#5258, so `linked_pr_unreferenced` silently stops applying.
- prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt:19-22 (prompts/_templates/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt lines 12-15) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `review_waiting_for_runner` bullet ends on the bare word "is" and states no age limit, although the code honours the flag only while the run is younger than REVIEW_RUN_MAX_RUNTIME_MINUTES (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22579, 22586).
  WHY: The judge gets an unfinished definition that overstates the flag's lifetime; the code enforces the hold, so the effect is clarity only.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22583, selector block 22578-22588 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The widened null/empty-`head_branch` arm (the trusted PR-named dispatch path, 27944-27953) is untested: the `_sjr` harness stages only `branch: "ai/issue-10"`, and the fake `gh` copy loop (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1859) does not copy `path`, `display_title` or `head_branch`.
  WHY: A regression to the old `!= "" and != $head_ref` form would silently re-escalate reviewable PRs to `ai:needs-human` with no test failing.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1461 and 1478 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `gh_retry` (default 5 attempts, scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1214) allows up to 11 requests per run, not the documented "1, or 3 when an open PR is found".
  WHY: changelog.d/9546-judge-blind-spots.md line 13 and agents.d/9546-judge-blind-spots.md understate the worst case; the retry itself matches CONSIST-001.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh line 2766 | risk_score=3
  PROBLEM: The diff read is single-attempt while its sibling reads are retried.
  WHY: Suggested fix: use `gh_retry_to_file "${RUNTIME_DIR}/linked_pr_diff.raw" gh api ...` so the existing `else`/`reason=diff_failed` path still fires; 2 lines.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh line 2767 (`head -c 120000 ...`) | risk_score=1
  PROBLEM: The full raw diff is written to disk before the 120 KB cap is applied.
  WHY: Suggested fix: pipe the read through `head -c 120000` into the raw file, or write it under `${RUNNER_TEMP}`; 2 lines.
- NOTES (3 related items): no new trust boundary (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1482-1491, 2859-2860); naming and kill switches are additive with default on; all Goals 1-5 and steps 1-10 are present, so no task gaps.
